title: Rune Mechanics
start: Speak to Apprentice Clerval in the basement of the Mage Training Arena.

items.t: 5 steam runes (you must craft one during the quest; the rest can be bought)
1 fire rune or water rune (needed to craft the steam rune; 5 if crafting all 5 steam runes during the quest)
Item to access fire altar if bringing water rune, or water altar if bringing fire rune (a fire talisman and water talisman are given to you in the quest)
Progress hat (and 5 or more pizazz points at the Mage Training Arena)

recommended.t: Transportation to Mage Training Arena such as a ring of duelling or mystical sand seed

rewards.t: Binding necklace, obtained during the quest with 14 charges left

steps.t: Talk to Apprentice Clerval in the basement of the Mage Training Arena. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Wizard Dougal who is also in the basement. [Chat: 1 Complement him and massage his ego.]

sub.t: You need four free spaces in your inventory for Dougal to give you items. If he doesn't give you the items, he will not accept the steam runes.

steps.t: Wear the binding necklace that Dougal gave you.
Craft at least one steam rune. The remaining runes (4 steam runes, 5 mind runes, 5 body runes) can be obtained or bought ahead of time.

sub.t: Steam runes can be crafted by using fire runes on the water altar (consuming a fire talisman).
Alternatively, use water runes on the fire altar (consuming a water talisman).

steps.t: Talk to Wizard Edvin who is also in the basement. (You will need to dismiss any pets currently active) [Chat: 1 I guess I'll give it a try.]

sub.t: From the start, go through the west portal, then go to the northern portal 3 times.

steps.t: Obtain five pizazz points from Mage Training Arena minigame, if you don't already have five. Enchantment Pizazz points are easy to obtain by casting any level jewellery enchantment spell (Lvl-1 Enchant, Lvl-2 Enchant, Lvl-3 Enchant, Lvl-4 Enchant, Lvl-5 Enchant, Lvl-6 Enchant) on a dragonstone lying on the arena floor. (Requires at least level 7 Magic.)
Talk to Wizard Shug on the top floor of the arena. [Chat: 2 Get back on topic! › 2 Get back on topic!]
Enchant the emeralds using the workbench by Clerval.
Talk to Clerval, holding 20 pure essence. [Chat: 2 Comfort and reassure him.]
p: The solution to the wire puzzle. (Click to enlarge.)

steps.t: When finished, click the green check button. [Chat: 1 You are useless, but, yes, I'll do it.]
Use the carving tool on the lump of rune essence.

start_overview: Mage Training Arena — North of Het's Oasis

get_inside.text: There are several quick ways of getting to the arena:
Mystical sand seed and running east.
Archaeology journal teleport and running south-east.
Fairy ring teleport to BIP and running south-west.
Wicked hood teleport to the Fire altar and running north-east.
A Ring of duelling teleport to Het's Oasis, then going north, north-east.
Home Teleport to the Al Kharid lodestone and going north east.
Dungeoneering cape teleport to Al Kharid resource dungeon and then running east.
